an4.124:1.1: “Monks, there are these four types of individuals to be found existing in the world.
an4.124:1.3: “There is the case where an individual, quite secluded from sensuality, secluded from unskillful qualities, enters & remains in the first jhāna: rapture & pleasure born of seclusion, accompanied by directed thought & evaluation.
an4.124:1.4: He regards whatever phenomena there that are connected with form, feeling, perception, fabrications, & consciousness, as inconstant, stressful, a disease, a cancer, an arrow, painful, an affliction, alien, a disintegration, an emptiness, not-self.
an4.124:1.5: At the break-up of the body, after death, he reappears in conjunction with the Devas of the Pure Abodes.
an4.124:1.6: This rebirth is not in common with run-of-the-mill people.
an4.124:2.1: “Again, there is the case where an individual… enters the second jhāna… the third jhāna… the fourth jhāna…
an4.124:2.2: He regards whatever phenomena there that are connected with form, feeling, perception, fabrications, & consciousness, as inconstant, stressful, a disease, a cancer, an arrow, painful, an affliction, alien, a disintegration, an emptiness, not-self.
an4.124:2.3: At the break-up of the body, after death, he reappears in conjunction with the Devas of the Pure Abodes.
an4.124:2.4: This rebirth is not in common with run-of-the-mill people.
an4.124:2.5: “These are four types of individuals to be found existing in the world.”
